# Recipe Index — full agent brief

Recipe Index is a static, source-linked comparison tool for 50 egg-free
vegetarian recipes. Admission requires at least 10 g protein per publisher
serving and at least 10 g protein per 100 calories calculated from protein and
calorie values published for that same serving.

## Audience and outcome

It is for vegetarian cooks in India who want realistic higher-protein food
ideas without abandoning familiar meals or ingredients. The useful outcome is
a shortlist of recipes whose nutrition basis, key ingredients, India fit, and
original source can be inspected before cooking.

## Collection shape

- 45 foods and five drinks.
- 14 credited publishers.
- Egg-free vegetarian; vegan recipes remain filterable.
- Soy, tofu, TVP, tempeh, seitan, dairy, legumes, whey, and vegan protein
  powder are all valid strategies when the evidence clears both gates.

## Evidence rules

Nutrition remains publisher-supplied and tied to the stated serving. Recipe
Index does not infer absent quantities, recalculate an ingredient list, or
promise that substitutions preserve the macros. It is not medical advice.

## Machine surfaces

- Home: https://veg-protein-food.significanthobbies.com/
- Markdown: https://veg-protein-food.significanthobbies.com/index.md
- Agent catalog: https://veg-protein-food.significanthobbies.com/api-ai.json
- Checked recipe data: https://veg-protein-food.significanthobbies.com/data/curated-recipes.json
- Sitemap: https://veg-protein-food.significanthobbies.com/sitemap.xml
